title: Register user with unique email address
gherkin:
Given a new user registration form
When the user enters a unique email address
Then the registration should succeed
And the user account should be created with that email address
rationale: Validates that users can successfully register with an email address that does not already exist in the system.
generationSummary: Test cases for validating that email addresses must be unique in the system. These tests cover scenarios for email uniqueness validation during user registration, account updates, and system state verification.

title: Reject registration with duplicate email address
gherkin:
Given an existing user with email 'user@example.com'
When a new user attempts to register with the same email 'user@example.com'
Then the registration should fail
And an error message should indicate the email is already in use
rationale: Ensures that the system prevents registration of duplicate email addresses, enforcing uniqueness constraint.
generationSummary: Test cases for validating that email addresses must be unique in the system. These tests cover scenarios for email uniqueness validation during user registration, account updates, and system state verification.

title: Update user email to unique address
